title: An agent session is not told which decade workspace it runs in
body:
decade starts an agent's process with `DECADE_WORKSPACE`, `DECADE_PANE` and `DECADE_MCP` in its environment (`decade/src/server/children.rs`). Only `DECADE_WORKSPACE` carries the workspace's name. The instructions the MCP server sends (`with_instructions` in `decade/src/server/mcp.rs`) speak of "the workspace this agent was started in" without naming it, and `git log -S` shows they never have. No session-start hook mentions decade. An agent learns from the instructions that it runs in decade, and learns which workspace only if it reads its environment.

Check 2 on acre's issue acre-8ed0f4 reads: "Something at session start tells the agent it runs in decade and names the workspace." A fresh Claude Code session under coax, in the workspace `acre`, failed it.

## Open

- Whether the server instructions name the workspace, or coax adds the name to the session's context at start. The MCP address carries `workspace=<n>`, so the server could probably name it per connection.
